title_zh: 罗马混凝土的永恒秘密
reveal_en: Ancient Roman concrete structures, like the Pantheon, have endured for millennia. Researchers discovered a self-healing process in their volcanic ash mixture, allowing them to repair micro-cracks and far outlast modern concrete.
reveal_zh: 古罗马的混凝土建筑，如万神殿，历经千年坚固不朽。研究发现其火山灰混合物可自修复微裂纹，寿命远超现代混凝土。
meaning_en: This reveals that "progress" isn't always linear, and ancient engineering held secrets modern science is only now rediscovering.
meaning_zh: 这揭示了“进步”并非总是直线，古代工程蕴含的秘密，现代科学仍在重新发现。

visual.motion: Fissures subtly close on an ancient concrete texture.
